Subject: Request: Crypto proof bundle for SIG / Q3 audit

Hi Mina,

We're starting our SIG questionnaire for Q3 and the security team has asked for a compact 'crypto proof bundle' covering KMS/HSM and key rotation controls. Can you provide the following artifacts and a short narrative for each?

- KMS architecture overview (which keys are CMKs, use of envelope encryption, aliases)
- HSM attestation or vendor statement of compliance for any customer-managed HSMs
- Key rotation logs for the last 12 months (rotation events, triggering mechanism, operator approvals where applicable)
- Access matrix showing who/what has decrypt/encrypt permissions for production CMKs
- Snapshot of effective KMS policies and IAM principals bound to key usage
- How we deliver audit logs (S3, SIEM, retention) and sample export (redacted)

We need material we can upload to the SIG portal by EOD next Wednesday (2028-08-23). If anything requires an NDA/SFTP transfer, please let me know the mechanism.

Thanks,
Gina Park
Security Program Manager, BluePeak

[Attachment: requested_scope_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Gina Park <gpark@bluepeak.com>
Date: 2028-08-15T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Crypto proof bundle for SIG / Q3 audit

Hi Gina — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a compact bundle that hits each item. Quick summary up front so you know what to expect:

- KMS: Hosted and Dedicated use AWS KMS CMKs that are HSM-backed (AWS CloudHSM-backed keys). For Private/BYOK deployments we support customer HSMs (Thales / Entrust / SafeNet) and accept vendor attestation PDFs. Envelope encryption is used at the application layer for large artifacts; service-level CMK aliases use the naming scheme alias/redwood/{env}-{service}.

- Rotation: Automated rotation is handled by our CryptoOps pipeline. For Redwood-managed CMKs we use scheduled rotation scripts (monthly cadence by default) with an automated promotion to the alias once new key material is validated. For BYOK keys we provide the rotation evidence the customer requests per their contract.

- Access: We will provide an access matrix (principals + least-privilege roles), a snapshot of effective KMS policies, and a redacted sample of audit log exports. No raw key material will be shared.

I have attached an initial manifest and will work with the CryptoOps team to compile: rotation logs (12 months), kms policy snapshot, HSM attestation, and the access matrix. If you prefer SFTP, we can drop the package to a time-limited SFTP location or provide a secure presigned S3 path.

Proposed timeline: preliminary package tomorrow EOD PDT, final upload and signature-ready bundle by 2028-08-21.

Would you like a 30-min sync with Marcus (CryptoOps) and Lauren (Compliance) to walk through any redaction needs?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: crypto_manifest_v1.txt (text)]

Hi all — attaching the compiled bundle and a short notes file. Items included in the package (redacted where necessary):

- rotation_logs_2027-08_to_2028-07.csv (columns: timestamp, key_alias, prior_key_id(redacted), new_key_id(redacted), rotation_reason, triggered_by (automation/manual))
- kms_policy_snapshot_20280814.yaml (policy dump of production CMKs, principals normalized)
- hsm_attestation_thales_202804.pdf (vendor-provided cert for customer HSM option)
- access_matrix_redwood.csv (role/principal -> key usage permissions)
- audit_log_delivery_instructions.txt (how to pull our S3 exports, retention policy, and sample redacted export)

Notes / short answers:
- KMS architecture: Redwood uses AWS KMS CMKs for hosted & dedicated customers; keys are CloudHSM-backed where regulatory requirements demand it. Envelope encryption is used for large object storage (S3) and the service layer maintains per-tenant envelope keys wrapped by CMKs. Alias convention: alias/redwood/{env}-{service}.
- Rotation: Default cadence is 30 days for service CMKs; rotation is implemented via our CryptoOps pipeline (orchestration via Lambda and step functions) with automated validation tests. Rotation events are logged to our audit S3 bucket; operator approvals are recorded in the rotation log when a manual override is performed.
- Access controls: KMS policies are least-privilege; cross-account grants are used for Dedicated integrations. We redact principal ARNs in shared artifacts on request.
- Audit delivery: We provide manifest + redacted samples via presigned S3 or secure SFTP. Full audit exports can be delivered under an executed DPA/NDA if required by the customer.

Delivery link (expires 7 days): s3://redwood-inference-evidence/bluepeak/crypto-bundle-20280815/ (manifest + files)
Jira ticket: INF-9821

If you want a short walk-through, I can join a 30-min sync tomorrow.
